correctness.rationale: Row-stochastic first-step laws give a single rank-one difference of transient matrices. Resolvent subtraction and exact two-state bunching wall equations imply the stated CDF generating-function factorization. Every coefficient remaining after f-b is nonnegative. Reachability proves the stated strictness and the N=2 exception; f,b>0 ensure absorption. Independently constructed exact rational Markov kernels and coefficients passed 17,760 checks across 40 cases; experiments are supplemental to the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2024 Marris–Giuggioli primary source studies the same two reflection protocols and general FPT distributions, so that background is attributed explicitly. Its inspected figures and text do not assert the uniform all-time CDF dominance or exact persistence-sign reversal for every start and laziness. The additional coefficientwise-positive resolvent factorization is a new comparison theorem relative to the inspected records. An indexed or unindexed equivalent result remains a stated priority risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed source might already establish an equivalent order by coupling or CDF inequalities.
Broad propagator formulas in the motivating work permit derivation of the present result, but do not alone explicitly assert coefficientwise positivity.
Indexed public-result summaries were not used to assert exclusion from any uninspected full manuscript.

value.rationale: The physically motivated choice of reflective wall interaction is evaluated simultaneously for every deadline and every increasing hitting-time loss, not just an example of density multimodality or a mean. It identifies a sharp universal persistence/anti-persistence protocol reversal, applies to arbitrary corridor lengths and starts, and has an exact proof with a meaningful two-site boundary exception.
